_comment: Pipeline settings, read by both languages. 'basic' reproduces 01-basic-rag: no deadline (each model call gets a fixed timeout: 60 s for the embedding, 120 s for the chat call) and no relevance gate. 'production' adds a deadline for the whole request and the relevance gate. relevance_threshold is chosen on the development questions only (evaluate.py, part 2), never on the test questions.
